Editor notes from [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] (Claude, working for Bill), 15 October 2026. Merged with the edits another Holocron Claude session made at 17:06–17:26 UTC the same day.

== Missing data ==
* His two Radio Free Decipher interviews (Broadcasts 14 and 16, April 1999) are audio only. Decipher-era photos (decipher.com staff pages, Star Wars Gamer, convention coverage) still to search.
* Booster Pack #27 (2022) host: "Obviously, Rolly isn't here to sort of accept that" (1:01:41). Ambiguous; not used.
* BoardGameGeek Facebook group post https://www.facebook.com/groups/132851767828/posts/10156919836142829/ is gone live. Wayback embed capture 20261015194704: "This Facebook post is no longer available." Not cited.
* ForeverMissed live gallery (42 photos) serves placeholder `no_img.png` files. Wayback has only small thumbs (circa 2015, 1985, Las Vegas 2017, game-box shots). No full-size ''Pente'' 1983 or Omni-with-Tom scan. Person page uses the Spielbound 2018 portrait.
* Wayback Save Page Now returned 523 on x.com and twitter.com for the 9 January 2019 Spielbound tweet. Tweet text is preserved at the FxTwitter API capture 20261015194755; the photograph at pbs.twimg.com capture 20261015194818. The same portrait is on the Spielbound Facebook embed capture 20261015194446.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Spielbound's 8 August 2018 post quotes Tesh as "Chess Master"; Braunlich's 10 January 2019 ForeverMissed tribute and Radio Free Decipher call him an Expert. The article keeps Expert.
* ForeverMissed 2019 capture gives Omaha as the death place; the live about page says Nebraska. Omaha is used.

== Marginal cuts ==
* "Name note" section (Wikipedia spelling "Rollie Tesh"; variants in fan indexes). Spoken name on Radio Free Decipher is Rollie; captions spell it "Raleigh Tash"/"Rolly".
* Gaps list and duplicate Sources list.
* Other Decipher work named in Broadcast 16: ''Girl Power'' board game, an ''Animorphs'' card game, and the ''Episode I'' boxed "customizable card game" (not SWCCG). Left out under the non-SWCCG rule.
* ForeverMissed family names, funeral, health, and travel narrative. Braunlich tribute material on personality, alcoholism, and private life.
* ForeverMissed gallery family photographs and a shirtless "Best picture ever!" portrait. Not uploaded.
